**Finding submitted: WARRANTY — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** Article 1 (p0004–p0014) imposes build/host/promote obligations on HDI but no warranty or remedy; the only performance consequence is the Section 1.6 termination right for late launch. Section 9 "Warranties" (p0055–p0058) is limited to corporate existence, authority, enforceability, no-conflict and a Globix acknowledgement. Searches for "warrant" and for AS IS / disclaimer / merchantability language returned no conformance warranty and no disclaimer, so nothing swallows an inserted warranty.
- **Classification:** No usable performance warranty exists anywhere, so the rule's clause is missing rather than a deviation.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` at the end of Section 9 adding new 9(c) at the fallback level — 90-day documentation conformance for the Site/HDI software, 30-day professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty, and repair/replacement, re-performance or refund of fees paid. No survival, expense or ancillary tails were added; Section 10.7 already causes Section 9 to survive.
